verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any public API, OpenAPI document, or downloadable spec. The llms.txt file found by the probe is crawler guidance for AI, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
